summary: Completed the first scenario-complete MP Materials common-stock review using its Q1 2026 Form 10-Q, issuer results release, and the canonical 4 August MACD-cross and volume-anomaly observations. Record NdPr output, initial profitable Magnetics operations, contractual price protection, 10X progress, and USD 1.738 billion of cash and short-term investments support the vertical-integration thesis, but government concentration, commodity exposure, construction risk, capital intensity, preferred capital, and dilution remain material. The deterministic assessment recorded a Hold rating, Watch portfolio action, quality score 72, medium confidence, and USD 20/USD 42/USD 75 bear/base/bull fair values with USD 44.75 probability-weighted fair value against USD 47.90999984741211. Allocation is ineligible because expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, and the accepted-relationship gate do not pass; no strategy, signal, paper order, issue, or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: MP Materials' Q1 2026 Form 10-Q reported USD 1.738 billion of cash and short-term investments, about USD 1.000 billion debt carrying value, USD 420.7 million preferred liquidation preference, USD 77.4 million quarterly capital expenditure, and 177.670 million common shares outstanding. It also documents the NdPr price floor, 10X offtake and minimum-EBITDA framework, customer and government concentration, construction obligations, dilution, and appropriation risks.

The issuer's Q1 2026 release reported 917 metric tons of NdPr production, 1,006 metric tons of NdPr sales, USD 90.6 million consolidated revenue, USD 42.3 million price-protection income, USD 36.6 million adjusted EBITDA, USD 21.1 million Magnetics revenue, USD 9.6 million Magnetics adjusted EBITDA, and groundbreaking at the 10X facility.

The canonical 4 August alert measured a 5.98% adjusted-close decline from 7 July through 4 August to USD 47.47 while MACD crossed above its signal line. The fresher 5 August close was USD 47.91 with MACD still above signal, so the review treated the crossover as constructive rebound timing rather than verified fundamental evidence or an entry signal.

The canonical 4 August volume alert recorded 10.3 million shares and strengthening anomalous volume over the same drawdown period; fresher 5 August volume normalized to 7.4 million shares, so the anomaly was not persistent and did not justify action.

Deterministic assessment version 2 derived USD 44.75 probability-weighted fair value, -6.5957% expected return, -4.9468% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 33.60 buy-below price, -14.0714% margin of safety, Hold canonical rating, Watch portfolio action, Watch conviction tier, and allocation ineligibility with complete threshold-frontier reasons.
